## Decision NNN — <Short Decision Name>

**Status:** Approved

**Decision:** One sentence. What was decided, stated as a fact about the system. No justification here.

**Context:** What was true at the time that made this decision necessary. Constraints, forces, prior decisions, founder priorities. A reader years from now must be able to tell whether the context still holds.

**Alternatives Considered:**
- *<Alternative A>* — one-line neutral description.
- *<Alternative B>* — one-line neutral description.

**Why Alternatives Were Rejected:** Address each alternative by name. Give the actual reason, not a summary judgement. An alternative rejected without a recorded reason will be re-proposed.

**Final Decision:** The decision restated unambiguously, in the form implementation can be checked against.

**Consequences:** What becomes true, what becomes harder, what downstream documents must now honour. Include negative consequences — an ADR that lists only benefits is not a decision record.

**Future Revisit Conditions:** The specific, observable conditions under which this decision should be re-examined. "None anticipated" is acceptable if genuinely true.

## Self-Review

Required. An ADR without an honest self-review is not reviewable.

**Remaining Ambiguity:** What this document leaves genuinely unclear, including where ambiguity was deliberate.

**Hidden Assumptions:** What this document assumes to be true without verifying. State each as a testable claim — assumptions recorded this way are how defects get caught.

**Founder Decisions Still Required:** Questions this document could not answer without founder authority.

**Conflicts with existing governance:** Check against every higher document in the precedence chain. State "no conflicts identified with X" explicitly — silence is not the same as a clean check.
